title: Quietly Silky Filipino Tofu Leche Flan
description: A plant-based Filipino dessert featuring panang-paste and agemono-deep-fry techniques, resulting in a silky and earthy leche flan. This dish is perfect for those looking for a unique and delicious dessert.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, combine the crumbled tofu, panang paste, coconut milk, maple syrup, vanilla extract, and salt, and blend until smooth.
Pour the mixture into 6 ramekins or small cups.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 45 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let them cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until chilled.
Just before serving, heat the agemono deep fry oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Carefully place the chilled leche flan in the hot oil and fry for 30 seconds on each side, or until golden brown.
Remove the leche flan from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
